title: workload.deployment.deployed v1 data
description: A workload reached its desired replica count and passed readiness at a known revision. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace the object lives in.

revision.description: Git revision (full SHA) the desired state came from.

image.description: Fully-qualified image reference, digest-pinned where the workload is.

replicas.description: Ready replica count observed at the time of the event.

observedGeneration.description: metadata.generation the controller had reconciled. Lets a consumer discard a stale event without ordering guarantees.
